// This fixture is source text, not a compiled package: it is stored as .txt so
// the repository's own build never links it. The scanner reads syntax, so the
// file only has to parse.
package sample

import "crypto/tls"

func serverConfig() *tls.Config {
	return &tls.Config{
		MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12,
		MaxVersion: tls.VersionTLS13,
		CipherSuites: []uint16{
			tls.TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,
			tls.TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA,
		},
		CurvePreferences: []tls.CurveID{
			tls.X25519MLKEM768,
			tls.CurveP256,
		},
	}
}

var configuredMinimum = tls.VersionTLS10

// The version arrives in a variable, so the scanner cannot report what this
// configures.
func legacyConfig() *tls.Config {
	return &tls.Config{MinVersion: configuredMinimum}
}
